evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New cleaning/dry-cleaning/laundry-service loanword article, including transitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: Professional clothing cleaning is positively taught without restricting the word to dry processes or making a professional/household-cleaning partition.

source.waller_definition: to be engulfed in,to be enveloped by,to wrap up

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana transitive godan article for wrapping, rolling or tucking something in a covering.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve raw engulfed/enveloped glosses but correct their intransitive implication: くるむ is transitive, with passive くるまれる. Add substantive 包 link and reciprocal alias-reading example without fabricating primary written-kanji metadata.
rows.identityNote: Recognized spelling 包む belongs to separate くるむ entry 2831360. Existing 包む keeps its N4 つつむ identity and entry 1584060; it is not reused for this row.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana adverb article for heartfelt insistence and repeated requests/warnings.
rows.sourceNote: Positively teach repetition as well as earnestness without treating the word as a neutral substitute for every often. The two effects can coexist; repeated prior requests are not obligatory.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive ichidan mouth-holding article at the source spelling; usual kana くわえる is explicit.
rows.sourceNote: The raw source gloss is blank, so sense 1 is an explicit bounded teaching choice. Complete sense 2 take along is preserved in evidence but not selected. 含む overlaps in mouth holding; 加える is an unrelated homophone.

rows.mappingNote: New modern county/district noun article, with selected sense explicitly restricted to ぐん.
rows.sourceNote: Modern Japanese 郡 groups towns/villages geographically under a prefecture, not an active county government. Historical district/Chinese commandery senses remain separate evidence.
rows.identityNote: Raw country is not taught as nation. Reading, supplied entry and inspected modern definition support county/district; historical こおり is not transferred to modern addresses.

rows.mappingNote: New practice/training/study noun and transitive suru article, with arts and martial-arts contexts.
rows.sourceNote: No absolute partition from 練習/訓練 or study words is asserted. 稽/古 association is explicitly a mnemonic, not an invented historical derivation; missing 稽 card is not manufactured.

rows.mappingNote: New honorific/polite-language category article, including a particular respectful-expression use.
rows.sourceNote: Traditional three-way classification is qualified against the inspected five-category guideline supplement. 敬語 is not reduced to 尊敬語 or mechanically adding お.

source.waller_definition: fluorescent lamp,person who is slow to react

rows.mappingNote: New fluorescent-lamp article positively teaches both source-selected senses, including the dated slow-person label.
rows.sourceNote: Sense 2 is marked dated and disparaging for recognition, not recommended as a neutral contemporary label. 蛍光 supplies fluorescence and 灯 the lamp; search-only alternate spellings remain evidence.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse stable 形式 article, preserve original senses 1-2 and identity, add sourced N2 level and bounded formality/mathematical-form coverage.
rows.sourceNote: Raw math expression is qualified to mathematical form such as quadratic form, not every mathematical expression. 二次形式 was absent as an exact pinned JMdict form and separately checked in the actual hosted Wikipedia introduction; philosophy sense 4 is not selected.
rows.identityNote: Previously unlevelled baseline identity retains title form; format, reading, kanji array, tags and previous teaching. The agreeing N2 row authorizes adding jlpt: 2.

rows.mappingNote: New continuation/maintenance/persistence noun and suru article with both transitive and intransitive constructions.
rows.sourceNote: Examples distinguish を for what is continued and が for the continuing state. Native 続く/続ける do not impose one-sided transitivity on the suru compound.

rows.mappingNote: New native-reading knitting-wool/woollen-yarn article, type wago.
rows.sourceNote: 毛 け + 糸 いと gives けいと, not an invented 毛 ケイ reading. Inspected Daijisen supports animal-hair yarn; the lesson does not assert that all synthetic knitting yarn is necessarily 毛糸.

rows.mappingNote: New longitude article distinguishing east-west coordinate measurement from the north-south direction of meridians.
rows.sourceNote: Longitude and latitude are complementary coordinates, not synonyms. 経/度 associations are mnemonics, not unverified etymology.

rows.mappingNote: New connected-system/lineage article, with additional related-group/color-family use.
rows.sourceNote: This is an explicit source-gloss qualification, not literal coverage of an unsupported geology meaning. Additional sense 3 does not independently gain an N2 assignment; specialist evolutionary/genetic senses remain complete evidence rather than required teaching.
rows.identityNote: Raw geological formation is preserved but not adopted: neither the complete pinned JMdict family nor the inspected Daijisen body establishes that unrestricted translation.

rows.mappingNote: New performing-arts/public-entertainment and cultivated-accomplishments article.
rows.sourceNote: Accomplishments/attainments means cultivated abilities/arts/skills, not completed tasks or achieved results. Actual Daijisen definitions support this interpretation; no obsolete or frequency label is inferred from historical quotations.

rows.mappingNote: New horse-racing noun article with whole-word ケイ + バ reading.
rows.sourceNote: Betting association does not make every spectator a bettor or the word a synonym for all gambling. Existing 競 ケイ examples gain actual links.

rows.mappingNote: New guarding/defense/protective-security noun and transitive suru article, including contextual policing duties.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish activity/arrangements from a security guard 警備員, safety as a condition and the police as an institution. No baseline exclusions are edited.

rows.mappingNote: New grammar-category noun article: adjective, with Japanese i-adjective interpretation explicitly framework-qualified.
rows.sourceNote: Raw true adjective is not a claim that na-adjectives are false. Introductory public entry inspection was partial 実用日本語表現辞典, not Daijisen. Final い alone is not a sufficient test; inflection and noun modification are illustrated.

rows.mappingNote: New adjectival-noun/na-adjective category article, distinguishing school-grammar citation だ and noun-modifying な.
rows.sourceNote: Modern learner stem analysis and classical なり/たり or related たる breadth are explicitly qualified, not flattened into a universal modern な rule. 動詞 substring does not make the described property an action.

rows.mappingNote: New surgical-department article with additional surgery-as-medical-specialty sense.
rows.sourceNote: 手術 names an operation. Department/specialty and operation share English surgery but are not made interchangeable Japanese nouns; visiting the department does not assert an operation occurred.

rows.mappingNote: New native-reading fur/animal-pelt article with primary けがわ.
rows.sourceNote: 毛 け + 皮 かわ voices the second part. Alternate もうひ is restricted to 毛皮; rare 毛革 permits けがわ but not もうひ. Radical-name sense 2 is not selected; rare alias does not create a primary-form reciprocal 革 pair.

quizGuardRationale: Exclusions are direct, symmetric and nontransitive; no baseline exclusions change. The 208 actual labels and complete relevant families inform the decisions, rather than comparing title strings alone. Shared topics are not automatically synonyms.

クリーニング protects broad cleaning/laundry/washing labels without claiming a professional-versus-home partition. くるむ protects actual wrapping, winding/rolling and covering overlap with 包む/巻く/覆う, while preserving the separate つつむ identity.

くれぐれも protects repeated/insistent, earnest and sincere answer areas, including their different grammatical realizations. It is not a neutral often in every sentence, and guards do not assert unrestricted substitution. 咥える protects actual mouth-holding overlap with 含む, broader holding 持つ and holding-between 挟む; unrelated 加える is not merged by sound.

郡 protects broad district/region/county labels. 県's foreign county sense is preserved in complete evidence without equating modern Japanese prefectures and 郡. 稽古 protects practice, training and study/learning labels without an exceptionless arts boundary.

敬語's category is not equated with every honorific action verb. The お prefix shares honorific/polite terminology, so the direct guard is conservative; specific actions such as eating or saying remain distinct.
蛍光灯 protects broad electric-light/lamp/illumination labels and the dated slow-person area against 鈍い/遅い. It does not equate every lamp technology or every physical slowness with that person label.

継続 protects continuation, continuing/keeping-going, maintenance/preservation and persistence/lasting. Complete ordinary secondary senses of 保存, 飽くまで and 持つ are considered; transitive/native counterpart guards are not assumed to transfer automatically.

毛糸 protects broad yarn and wool labels. 毛 as hair/fur and 毛皮 as a pelt are distinguished by material form; no automatic guard is inferred solely from sharing 毛. 経度 and 緯度 are complementary different coordinates, not alternative answers.

系統 protects actual system wording and ordinary related-type/lineage/family or school-of-thought areas. 一家's complete school/style use and 身体's physical-system label matter beyond their household/body primary presentations. Guards do not equate every organized group or literal household with ancestry. Separate 一種 supplement supplies its full category/variety and approximation senses.

芸能 protects arts/performance and cultivated skill/ability wording, including 腕's ordinary ability sense rather than only the arm title. It does not make completed results or every achieved goal an accomplishment in this sense.

競馬 protects broad race/competition labels, not every betting or gambling word. 警備 protects guarding/protection/security labels, including 番's complete watch/guard sense; 安全 as a desired condition is distinguished in prose. 警察 as an institution and 警備員 as a person are not silently merged.

形容詞/形容動詞 protect the framework-dependent broad English adjective area, with modern school-grammar distinctions positively taught. 外科/手術 protect English surgery ambiguity without erasing specialty/department versus operation.

毛皮 protects broad fur/skin/pelt labels while qualifying the animal hair-bearing material. 毛/皮 are broader; 皮膚/肌 have skin overlap but are not taught as default synonyms for fur clothing. Processed 革 and wool/yarn are not merged merely because all can be materials.

Existing 形式 keeps its original title and exclusions. Its new formality and narrowly qualified mathematical-form teaching do not assert that every expression is a 形式. Pre-existing baseline-to-baseline ambiguity is not silently repaired as unrelated scope.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles and one reused 形式 cover twenty source rows. The reused article's actual old teaching was inspected; it gains an N2 level and narrow coverage while preserving identity and existing prose.
The source's blank 咥える gloss does not specify every family sense. Core mouth-holding is an explicit selected choice; take-along remains unselected complete evidence.

Exact forms きれいだ and 二次形式 were absent from the first pinned extraction request; that request failed explicitly. They were removed before successful 229-form extraction, not fabricated as JMdict receipts. 二次形式 was separately checked in the actual hosted Wikipedia introduction.
Ten primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs are added on nine kanji cards, plus the substantive 包/くるむ alias-reading link. Rare 毛革 does not create a primary-form 革 pair.
Missing primary component cards 咥, 郡, 稽, 蛍, 継, 系 and 統 are not manufactured; all written characters remain in word metadata. Existing other written components are substantively linked.
Complete families include unrelated homographs, search-only forms and unselected specialist/historical senses. Their presence is not permission to transfer meanings, readings or restrictions.
The community source is not an official JLPT syllabus. Additional senses and quiz-only senses do not independently gain N2 classification.
Public receipts record actual qualified author access. Original examples are not corpus quotations, frequency measurements, native-speaker certification or executed app draws.

All baseline identities, primary readings, titles, kanji arrays, tags, easier levels and established exclusions remain preserved. The sole already-recorded baseline-exclusion exception is batch-19 機械/道具.

Component associations are learning aids, not fabricated historical etymologies. Initial reviewer evidence omits only quizGuardRationale; mapping/source notes remain visible author assertions, not adjudicated reviewer findings.

quizEvidence.系統/筋: Principal 1251030 senses 1-2 and 筋/すじ 1241750 sense 7 explicitly share lineage. The existing 筋 article's selected senses do not erase that ordinary secondary meaning.
quizEvidence.formQuartet: 形式/1250310 senses 1-3, 形/かたち 1250220 sense 3, 型/かた 1250090 senses 1,3-4, and 式/しき 1319060 sense 1 establish form, manner, type or pattern overlap. 型 sense 4 also includes formula. All six direct pairs are declared because exclusions are not transitive and apply between other choices.
quizEvidence.芸能/能: 芸能's cultivated-ability sense overlaps 能/のう 1470120 sense 1 talent; noh in sense 2 also belongs to performing arts. This is not unrestricted substitution of generic 芸能 for the theatre name.
quizEvidence.芸能/教養: 教養/1237370 sense 1 concerns cultivation/refinement; Daijisen 芸能 senses 2-3 explicitly cover learned abilities and accomplishments acquired as cultivation. The broad English accomplishments label warrants a conservative guard.
quizEvidence.敬語/御中/氏: 敬語 includes particular respectful expressions. Actual 御中/おんちゅう 1270530 and 氏/し 2101130 cards teach respectful suffixes, unlike search-only 御中/おなか 1002610 or 氏/うじ 1311010. Existing 御中/氏 exclusion is retained.

wordingChanges.芸能: Remove the unverified invented 芸能を身につける collocation. Positive cultivated-accomplishments teaching and both principal senses remain; no obsolete or frequency label is invented.
wordingChanges.形式: Translate 形式を整える as put something into proper form without narrowing every occurrence to processing formalities.
